atoms.text:
Parts of the continent of Africa are located both above and below the equator. It is surrounded by the Indian Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, the Red Sea and the Mediterranean Sea. In terms of land mass, it’s the second-largest continent.

Africa is also home to the African Union (AU); a union of the 55 countries that make up Africa. The African Union was founded in 2002 in South Africa. The African Union represents over 1.3 billion people and around 30 million `km`^2 of land.

Within Africa, there is said to be over 1000 languages — many of which are thousands of years old. The most spoken language is Swahili, with around 200 million speakers, followed by Yoruba, a Nigerian language which has around 45 million speakers.
